scope.key_space: existing eight sampled spatial keys pooled within each reference time

interpretation: The frozen full-support zero-shift STOP test passed in every predeclared direction and valid bin; no head, step or time was selected.
The result establishes stable same-coordinate reference fingerprints across the two conditional trajectories at each sampled step.
A pure positional code C_t=e_t passes exactly the same test even with static visual content. The current capture set therefore does not identify content displacement or action delay.

The old cross-spatial test and this test differ in both preservation of spatial identity and joint multihead fingerprinting. Their contrast is not a single-factor causal attribution to spatial pooling.
The 124 cells are correlated observations of one source clip, not 124 independent samples. Nominal-bin centers are not precise VAE receptive fields or pixel action timestamps.

next_evidence_required.fixed_observer: Keep the same layer, steps, all heads/probes, normalization, retrieval, key support and frozen source dictionary.
next_evidence_required.content_coordinate_separation: Known positive and negative content-time changes while query positional coordinates remain fixed; form test query distributions against the original fixed reference K dictionary.
nulls: Static reference must remain temporally ambiguous or explicitly rejected, not decoded from position alone.
Time-preserving appearance changes must keep the known coordinate or report out-of-support; a confident wrong shift is failure.
next_evidence_required.mapping: Predefine common valid support, non-circular boundary handling and exact transformation before observing data. A role-preserving five-bin shift is nominal17frames, a coarse content/position test; finer action timing would still need its own evidence.
next_evidence_required.method_limit: Reference-domain calibration first. Generated-query transfer and the actual H3 local-chain directional derivative are separate unmeasured quantities.
next_evidence_required.run_scope: Potential bounded passive forward captures only after a separate plan is approved; this decision schedules none.
